title: KODEX — KFORGE: inverse-design
description:
KODEX — KFORGE (inverse-design). inverse-design capstone — chains the fleet surrogates (KYRO transport + KORE equilibrium feasibility) to search machine designs; the underlying KYRO transport is CGYRO mu=400 representative-mass (real-mass converged gold deferred), so the operating point is representative, not final

Benchmark: inverse-design chained KYRO+KORE → **found a quiet operating point** (a/L_T=2.194, shear=1.584, Q_tot≈0.0)

Part of KODEX, the Kronos Family of Codes — a benchmarked AI/ML fusion surrogate suite with calibrated uncertainty and an abstention gate (predict(x) → (y, uncertainty, in_domain)). Provenance: isDerivedFrom 10.5281/zenodo.22136279. Home: https://kronosfusionenergy.com/kodex/kforge · suite: https://github.com/KronosFE/kronos-ml. Licensed under Apache-2.0. Honest card preserved verbatim.
